sloka: कथं त्वं राक्षसैरेभिर्मया च परिरक्षितः ।जिघांसुभिर्दाशरथिं वध्यसे त्वमिहानघ ।। ६.६३.३९ ।।
transliteration: kathaṁ tvaṁ rākṣasairebhirmayā ca parirakṣitaḥ ।jighāṁsubhirdāśarathiṁ vadhyase tvamihānagha ।। 6.63.39 ।।

translations.english: "Now you will see Sugriva the foremost of monkeys in mountain shape, resembling mountains bathed in blood like evening Sun illumined like the cloud."
